thread.title: Smartphones: Market Share Looks Set to Hold Steady

author: David Marino-Nachison
title: Smartphones: Market Share Looks Set to Hold Steady
text:
Photo: Getty Images Smartphone operating system market share is expected to hold largely fast between now and 2022.
On Tuesday morning, IDC released new projection s that pointed toward slim changes for Android and Barron’s Next 50 stock Apple’s (AAPL) iOS over the next five years. 
Android market share, at 85.1% in 2017, was seen ticking up only slightly to 85.5%, according to IDC, while that of iOS was expected to tick downward, from 14.8% to 14.4%. 
Shipment volumes, meanwhile, were expected to grow at a 2.9% compounded annual rate over the next five years for Android, developed by Alphabet’s (GOOGL) Google, and 2.4% for Apple. 
*Table Note: 2022 figures are forecast projections. Illustration: IDC Worldwide smartphone shipments fell 0.5% last year, according to IDC, which expects low single-digit growth in 2018.
